subject: Citywide Rodent Control
overview: The Committee of the Whole met with Public Health Director MaryAnn O'Connor to discuss rodent mitigation efforts across the city. The council approved a motion to establish an interdepartmental emergency rodent team and develop a multilingual public education campaign.

items.title: Paper 23-416: Rodent Issues in the City
items.summary: Public Health Director MaryAnn O'Connor outlined current rodent mitigation methods, inspection data, and dumpster enforcement, after which the council approved a motion to form a cross-departmental emergency rodent team and direct the communications department to create a multilingual educational plan.
